title: Mobile Game Update! | COPICafe Episode 31 | Cornucopias
description:
Mobile Game Update, New Stake Pool Leaks and More!

In this episode of COPICafe Josh and Rob discuss a new hire and answer some questions about the upcoming team token release schedule that the community have been inquiring about. They also discuss the new development of the mobile game. Also announced is the addition of the "Grow Your Stake" stake pool (Ticker GYS) as the "COPI" stake pool nears saturation. The guys also discuss the upcoming Cardano Summit and also welcome special guest Mark, the marketing designer for Cornucopias. Ending with a some really great leaks from the art department along with a special treat at the end thanks to "Corn-Roach" from the Knights Guild.
